description: Resolves a postal code in one country (ISO 2-letter code, e.g. US, DE, TR, GB) to its place names, state or province, and latitude and longitude, from Zippopotam.us. Covers only the countries that service publishes. No time zone or administrative municipality is returned, since no free source for them was used. Takes about 14 s; allow a 30 s timeout. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code, e.g. US, DE, TR, GB

postalCode.description: Postal code as written for that country, 2 to 12 characters

name: agent_intel_global_postal_geocode_resolver
title: Resolves a postal code in one country to its place names
